title: OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.26333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Numerical simulation is important in ocean engineering, but model construction requires expert knowledge. Large language models support automated modelling, but code syntax and successful execution alone do not establish whether generated models and results meet engineering requirements. We present OceanCoder, a Qwen3-8B-based large language model for automated simulation modelling in ocean engineering. To address specialised programming requirements and scarce training data, we develop an extensible data construction pipeline producing 12,000 verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples across 12 engineering task categories. A three-layer verification framework checks model inputs against engineering parameters and task constraints, verifies completion of required simulation analyses, and assesses the engineering plausibility of computed outputs. translated_title: OceanCoder：面向海洋工程自动化仿真建模的验证引导大语言模型
translated_abstract: 数值仿真在海洋工程中十分重要，但模型构建需要专家知识。大语言模型可以支持自动化建模，然而代码语法正确和能够成功执行并不代表生成的模型和结果满足工程要求。我们提出了 OceanCoder，一个基于 Qwen3-8B、面向海洋工程自动化仿真建模的大语言模型。为应对专业化的编程需求和训练数据稀缺的问题，我们开发了一个可扩展的数据构建流程，生成了涵盖 12 类工程任务的 12,000 条经过验证的监督微调（SFT）样本。一个三层验证框架用于检查模型输入是否符合工程参数与任务约束、验证所需仿真分析是否完成，并评估计算结果的工程合理性。其评估结果为群体相对策略优化（GRPO）提供分级奖励，引导……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: OceanCoder 通过可扩展数据流水线和三层验证框架为 GRPO 提供分级奖励，构建了一个能自动生成满足工程要求仿真模型的海洋工程专用大语言模型。
en_tdlr: OceanCoder is a Qwen3-8B-based LLM that uses an extensible data pipeline and a three-layer verification framework providing graded rewards for GRPO to automate simulation modelling that meets engineering requirements in ocean engineering.
